Action.description: GET requests use Action=Get query param. POST uses body.

MaxDuration.description: ISO 8601 duration string (e.g. 'PT4H', 'P1D', 'P28D') or null/empty for no limit. Formatter sends MaxDuration?.value ?? null — unwraps from autocomplete object.

allOf.description: Autocomplete/select field. Most dropdowns in CIPP use this shape. Backend typically unwraps via: $x.value ?? $x

AdminRoles.description: Array of admin roles to assign. LabelValue shape: { "label": "Role Display Name", "value": "<ObjectId>" }. The value must be the role's ObjectId (GUID). Retrieve available roles from GET /api/ListRoles?TenantFilter=<tenant>.

allOf.description: Autocomplete/select field. Most dropdowns in CIPP use this shape. Backend typically unwraps via: $x.value ?? $x

Domain.description: Domain for the new user's UPN. Required when userAction="create". Accepts a LabelValue object ({ "label": "contoso.com", "value": "contoso.com" }) or a plain domain string. PS1 unwraps .value with fallback to the raw string.

EndDate.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) for when the JIT access expires. The scheduler removes/disables the user at this time per ExpireAction.

allOf.description: Autocomplete/select field. Most dropdowns in CIPP use this shape. Backend typically unwraps via: $x.value ?? $x

ExpireAction.description: Action to perform when JIT access expires. LabelValue shape: { "label": "...", "value": "<action>" }. Valid values: "DisableUser" (disable the account), "DeleteUser" (permanently delete), "RemoveRoles" (userAction=select only), "RemoveGroups" (userAction=select only), "RemoveRolesAndGroups" (userAction=select only). Accepts a plain string instead of a LabelValue object.

FirstName.description: First name for the new user. Required when userAction="create".

allOf.description: Autocomplete/select field. Most dropdowns in CIPP use this shape. Backend typically unwraps via: $x.value ?? $x

GroupMemberships.description: Array of groups to add the user to. LabelValue shape: { "label": "Group Display Name", "value": "<ObjectId>" }. The value must be the group's ObjectId (GUID). Used when ExpireAction includes group removal.

LastName.description: Last name for the new user. Required when userAction="create".

PostExecution.description: Notification actions to trigger after JIT access is granted. Array of strings. Valid values: "Webhook", "email", "PSA".

StartDate.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) for when JIT access begins. Defaults to immediate if omitted.

UseTAP.description: If true, generates a Temporary Access Pass instead of a password for the new user. Only applicable when userAction="create".

allOf.description: Autocomplete/select field. Most dropdowns in CIPP use this shape. Backend typically unwraps via: $x.value ?? $x

existingUser.description: Target user when userAction="select". LabelValue shape: { "label": "User Display Name", "value": "<UPN or ObjectId>" }. If value is a GUID (ObjectId), the PS1 resolves it to a UPN automatically via Graph. Required when userAction="select".

allOf.description: Autocomplete/select field. Most dropdowns in CIPP use this shape. Backend typically unwraps via: $x.value ?? $x

jitAdminTemplate.description: Template to pre-populate defaults from. LabelValue shape: { "label": "Template Name", "value": "<GUID>" }. Retrieve available templates from GET /api/ListJITAdminTemplates?TenantFilter=<tenant>.

reason.description: Justification text for why JIT access is being granted. Stored on the JIT admin record.

tapLifetimeInMinutes.description: Lifetime of the Temporary Access Pass in minutes. Only used when UseTAP=true. Must be within the tenant's TAP policy limits. Omit to use the tenant default.

tenantFilter.description: Target tenant domain or GUID. Required.

allOf.description: Autocomplete/select field. Most dropdowns in CIPP use this shape. Backend typically unwraps via: $x.value ?? $x

usageLocation.description: Usage location for the new user (required by Microsoft for license assignment). LabelValue shape: { "label": "Country Name", "value": "<ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code>" } — e.g. { "label": "Canada", "value": "CA" }. Accepts a plain country code string. Only used when userAction="create".

userAction.description: Whether to create a new user or target an existing one. "create" requires FirstName, LastName, username, Domain. "select" requires existingUser.

username.description: Username prefix (without domain) for the new user. Combined with Domain to form the UPN. Required when userAction="create".

Action.description: Query param for Remove|Resume|Suspend actions on existing requests. Not sent by this form.

AssociatedMessagesCopyOption.description: Enum: DoNotCopy|MapByMessageClass|Copy. PS1 reads .value from the object.

ExcludeFolders.description: Array of folder specifiers e.g. '#Inbox#'. PS1 reads .value from array items.

Identity.description: Existing restore request identity for Remove/Resume/Suspend. Not sent by this form.

IncludeFolders.description: Array of folder specifiers. PS1 reads .value from array items.

SourceMailbox.description: Formatter sends ExchangeGuid from addedFields if present, otherwise UPN. PS1 reads .value ?? raw value. NOTE: formatter pre-resolves to ExchangeGuid string, so PS1 receives the guid directly.

TargetMailbox.description: Same as SourceMailbox — ExchangeGuid or UPN string.

TenantFilter.description: Formatter sends as 'TenantFilter' (capital T). PS1 reads $Request.Body.TenantFilter.

CreatePolicies.description: Array of policy objects to create: [{Name: string, RetentionPolicyTagLinks: string[]}]. Sent when isEdit=false.

DeletePolicies.description: Array of policy identity strings to delete. Not sent by this form but accepted by PS1.

ModifyPolicies.description: Array of policy modification objects: [{Identity: string, Name: string, RetentionPolicyTagLinks: string[]}]. Sent when isEdit=true.

CreateTags.description: Array of tag objects to create: [{Name, Type, Comment, RetentionAction, AgeLimitForRetention, RetentionEnabled, LocalizedComment, LocalizedRetentionPolicyTagName}]. Sent when isEdit=false.

DeleteTags.description: Array of tag identity strings to delete. Not sent by this form but accepted by PS1.

ModifyTags.description: Array of tag modification objects: [{Identity: original name, Name?, Comment?, RetentionAction?, AgeLimitForRetention?, RetentionEnabled?, LocalizedComment?, LocalizedRetentionPolicyTagName?}]. Sent when isEdit=true.
